alt: Three methods. A regular block: measure length, width and height and find its mass. An irregular stone: the rise in a measuring cylinder reading when it is lowered in on a thread is its volume. A large object: the water overflowing from a displacement can filled to the spout is its volume.
caption: Find the mass on a balance; find the volume by measuring or by displacement; ρ = m ÷ V.

alt: An empty measuring cylinder reads 82.0 g on a balance; with 50.0 cm³ of oil it reads 128.0 g. The oil has mass 46.0 g, so its density is 46.0 ÷ 50.0 = 0.920 g/cm³, or 920 kg/m³.
caption: Subtract the mass of the empty cylinder before dividing by the volume.

alt: A 600 N person stands on three different areas. Flat shoes of area 0.040 m² give 15 000 Pa, snowshoes of 0.30 m² give 2000 Pa, and one heel of 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ m² gives 6.0 × 10⁶ Pa.
caption: The same 600 N force gives a much larger pressure on a smaller area.

after: ## Pressure in a fluid acts in all directions (5.6)
alt: Left: at one point in a liquid, equal arrows push outwards in every direction while particles move randomly. Right: water spurts sideways equally from two holes at the same height in a bottle, and further from a hole lower down.
caption: At any point in a fluid at rest, pressure acts equally in all directions and increases with depth.

alt: A diver 25 m below the sea surface. The pressure difference is 25 × 1030 × 10 = 257 500 Pa; adding atmospheric pressure of 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa gives a total of 3.6 × 10⁵ Pa.
caption: p = h × ρ × g gives the extra pressure; add atmospheric pressure for the total.

alt: A submarine 200 m below the sea surface with a window of area 0.050 m². The water pressure is 200 × 1030 × 10 = 2.06 × 10⁶ Pa, so the extra force on the window is 2.06 × 10⁶ × 0.050 = 1.03 × 10⁵ N.
caption: Find the pressure from the depth, then multiply by the area for the force.

alt: A storage tank on a hill feeds a tap 15 m below the water surface, giving a pressure difference of 150 000 Pa. A house further down the hill has a larger vertical height below the surface and a larger pressure difference.
caption: h is the vertical depth below the water surface, never the length of pipe.
